mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS listing_id, COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS qty FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_order o ON o.store_id = l.store_id AND o.order_time >= #{since} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') JOIN ecom_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.seller_sku = l.seller_sku WHERE l.id IN #{id} GROUP BY l.id
